description: This file defines Redux actions related to user signup in a React/Redux application, including handling form changes, validation, API calls for registration, and dispatching success or error notifications.

methods.name: signupChange
methods.description: Creates an action to update the signup form data for a specific field.

methods.name: subscribeChange
methods.description: Creates an action to toggle or change the subscription status.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Asynchronous thunk action that validates the signup form, makes an API call to register the user, handles success and error notifications, and updates the Redux state accordingly.
